got: roster land     24 active (0 in season now),   0 inactive

claim: `roster KEY inactive` leaves the species inactive with no seasons; `roster KEY active` makes it active with exactly one season; each is one undo step and one ledger line
expected: an active species with one season on this fort

claim: `seasons KEY SpAu` sets exactly those seasons; `seasons KEY none` is refused and changes nothing; a bad code prints usage
expected: an active species with one season on this fort

claim: `undo` after a console roster or seasons edit restores the state before it
expected: an active species with one season on this fort

claim: `seasons KEY Wi` on an inactive species makes it active in Winter
expected: an inactive species on this fort
